goal: Prove the same ONE PIECE editorial system can support a dense deck-building and publishing tool without adding showcase decoration or reducing task efficiency.
mustPreserve: sheet fields, states and business mutations

requiredDirection.surface: warm-white work surface with navy utility header and restrained ruled sections
requiredDirection.composition: compact editing header -> single search -> compact filters/view mode -> card pool -> persistent deck tray/publish action
requiredDirection.controls: consistent rectangular input/filter/stepper/button/sheet family with visible default/selected/focus/disabled/error/success states
requiredDirection.geometry: low radius, 1px rules, no pills and no Hero
requiredDirection.colorRoles: red only primary publish/error as semantics allow; yellow sparse selection; navy structure; preserve validation and disabled colors
requiredDirection.type: CJK readable task hierarchy; display styling limited to short numeric counts

acceptance: 390/536/1280 show editing context, search, filters and usable pool/tray without overflow
publish remains visually obvious and all form states are distinguishable
pointer/keyboard interactions and business validation are unchanged
masked system recognition comes from component family/rules/type, not imagery
